title: The Security Deposit on Your Home-Site Lease
content:
**Home-Site Lease — holding and returning the security deposit**

The security deposit is held for the whole tenancy and is never applied to rent while the lease is open, including as a last month's rent. A deposit is disposed of only after the lease is closed, as the lease record shows.

**When the lease closes**

- When the rent balance on the closed date is zero or a credit and no deduction is taken, the whole deposit plus any credit balance is refunded within the lot class's refund period, in calendar days of the closed date.
- Otherwise the deposit is first applied to the rent balance, up to the full deposit; the remainder is refunded with an itemized claim within the lot class's claim period, in calendar days of the closed date; and any balance the deposit does not cover remains owed by the former resident.
- Damage to the site itself is assessed by the community office at the move-out inspection and is outside the resident desk; disputes about such deductions go to a human representative.

**Worked dispositions (hypothetical deposit of 700.00)**

| Rent balance on the closed date | Applied to the balance | Refunded | Still owed by the former resident | Period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| a credit of 40.00, no deduction | none | 740.00 (deposit plus credit) | none | refund period |
| zero, no deduction | none | 700.00 | none | refund period |
| 250.00 | 250.00 | 450.00 with an itemized claim | none | claim period |
| 900.00 | 700.00 | none | 200.00 | claim period |

**Questions on the deposit**

*May the deposit be used as the last month's rent?* No. It is never applied to rent while the lease is open.

*When is anything decided about the deposit?* Only after the lease has closed.
